ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity distribution; approximately 95% of pixels are in the 0-50 range (black/dark grey) with sparse 200-255 range (white) focal speckling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform low-intensity pigmentation across both lobes. High-contrast white focal spots and fine-grained speckling distributed sporadically across the central and mid-distal ventral surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression; interior angle approximately 40-50 degrees relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire continuous trailing edge; characterized by irregular peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward concave curvature originating from the median notch and terminating at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast pixel clusters located on the extreme distal tips of both lobes; visible as irregular, rough-textured white/grey masses.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, multi-directional high-intensity linear disruptions (white) detected across the lower central region of the fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular protrusions on the leading and trailing edges of both distal tips, consistent with localized surface trauma or parasitic colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Localized pixel occlusion along the lower ventral boundary due to high-contrast water spray and droplet spray patterns.
